name: bottoms-up-kettlebell-turkish-get-up
instructions:
1. Setup in a side lying position with the kettlebell in a front racked position and your hands overlapped on the handle.
2. Roll onto your back and rotate the kettlebell into a bottoms up position using your free hand.
3. Press the kettlebell to extension and extend your free hand to the side.
4. Raise the knee on the same side as the kettlebell. (i.e. if you’re holding the weight in your R hand, your R knee should be flexed)
5. Sit up to the elbow as you punch the kettlebell overhead.
6. Extend the elbow you’re braced on and push yourself up to your hand.
7. Bridge the hips up while keeping one leg straight.
8. Once the hips are extended, sweep the straight leg through and assume a half kneeling position with one hand still on the floor and the other overhead.
9. Bring the torso upright, reposition the down leg so that it’s in-line with the forward leg, and then drive up to a standing position out of the half kneeling stance.
10. From the standing position, simply step back in a reverse lunge to revert to the half kneeling position.
11. Repeat steps #1-8 in reverse order to get back to the supine starting position.
12. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
starting_position: 1. Setup in a side lying position with the kettlebell in a front racked position and your hands overlapped on the handle. 2. Roll onto your back and rotate the kettlebell into a bottoms up position using your free hand.
